project.description: This job needs a refactor. Should just be determining if it's in the new metadata.json format or the older version. Do the JQ transform to the new format more transparent and simpler.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
# ============================= # Verbosity / logging controls # ============================= LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
AWS_CLI_EXTRA=() if [[ "${VERBOSE_AWS:-0}" == "1" ]]; then AWS_CLI_EXTRA+=(--debug) log "AWS CLI debug logging ENABLED" fi
# ============================= # Config # ============================= ROLE_ARN="arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl" ROLE_SESSION_NAME="s3-test" ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS=3600
: "${stdy_id:?stdy_id is required}" : "${abv:?abv is required}" : "${api:?api is required}"
stdy_id_lc="${stdy_id,,}" abv_lc="${abv,,}"
metadata_file="${stdy_id_lc}_${abv_lc}_metadata.json" output_file="${stdy_id_lc}_${abv_lc}_output.json" assume_out="assume-role-output.json"
# ============================= # Cleanup # ============================= cleanup() { log "Cleaning up temporary credentials" unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN rm -f "$assume_out" } trap cleanup EXIT
# ============================= # Prereqs # ============================= need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
log "Validating prerequisites" need aws need jq need curl log "Prerequisites OK"
# ============================= # Assume role # ============================= log "Assuming role: $ROLE_ARN (session=$ROLE_SESSION_NAME, duration=${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS}s)" aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS" \ --role-arn "$ROLE_ARN" \ --role-session-name "$ROLE_SESSION_NAME" \ "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}" \ > "$assume_out"
log "Parsing temporary credentials" export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_out")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_out")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_out")" log "Role assumed successfully"
# ============================= # Download metadata # ============================= log "Downloading metadata file: $metadata_file" aws s3 cp \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/${metadata_file}" \ "$metadata_file" \ --no-progress \ "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}"
if [[ ! -f "$metadata_file" ]]; then warn "Metadata file not found after initial download attempt, retrying" aws s3 cp \ "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/${metadata_file}" \ "$metadata_file" \ --no-progress \ "${AWS_CLI_EXTRA[@]}" fi
if [[ ! -f "$metadata_file" ]]; then error "Metadata file still missing after retry: $metadata_file" exit 1 fi
log "Metadata download complete"
# ============================= # Transform # ============================= log "Deduplicating concepts by concept_path" jq '.' "$metadata_file" \ | jq 'group_by(.concept_path) | map(.[0])' \ > "$output_file" || exit 255
log "Output written: $output_file"
# ============================= # Upload to API # ============================= log "Uploading curated concepts to API (datasetRef=${stdy_id_lc})" curl --request PUT --fail \ --header 'Content-Type: text/json' \ --data @"$output_file" \ "${api}/concept/curated?datasetRef=${stdy_id_lc}"
log "API upload completed successfully" log "Job finished successfully"
